name: Shocking Grasp
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Dexterity against an adjacent creature. The attack roll is favored if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the creature takes 1d8 damage, and it can’t use reactions until the start of its next turn.

If the Condition you unchecked was Angry, +1d damage.

Describe the shock.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: The creature takes -1 action for 1 round.
